mapper.sql: game_id, image_key, name, description, image_base64, mime_type, byte_size, width, height, enabled, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM public.images WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND image_key = #{imageKey} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.images ( game_id, image_key, name, description, image_base64, mime_type, byte_size, width, height, enabled ) VALUES ( #{gameId}, #{imageKey}, #{name}, #{description}, #{imageBase64}, #{mimeType}, #{byteSize}, #{width}, #{height}, TRUE )
